o_hi: Decreased by 12.41%12.41% की कमी
Increased by 12.41%12.41% की वृद्धि

Increased by 13.85%13.85% की वृद्धि
questions_hin.s_hi:
For 15% increase in 1st year and 15% decrease in second year =>

Equivalent percentage = 15 - 15 - 15*15/100 = -2.25 decrease

For 15% increase in 3rd year =>

= 12.75 - 0.3375

= 12.41% increased
